source_prompt:
# Instructions for accurately documenting excessive industrial emissions in an air-quality report

1. Start with the monitoring records.
2.
completion:
Determine the number of working days (i.e., total hours) in the permit period for which compliance was assessed. See *Note #1*. 
    1. Identify the actual count of days with authorized emissions (i.e., hours).
    2. Identify the planned and unplanned outages. *Note #2*
        1. Remove planned outages unless operation during the outage is addressed elsewhere in the permit. *Note #3*
        1. Remove unplanned outages. See *Note #4*.
    3. Remove periods during which no emissions are allowed. See *Note #5*
    4. See *Note #6*.
3. For each day/unit for which compliance must be demonstrated, total the emissions (in tons per month) by pollutant.
4. Calculate the total of the monitored emissions over the compliance period. 
5. Refer to the current permit. *Note #7*
